page.layout: One scanned image: the front binding of a book, not a printed page. Blind-tooled leather boards with decorative frame, a central panel with a small tooled inscription at its foot, two metal clasps with hinges on the left edge, and five raised bands on the spine at the right. No printed text block is visible.
page.notes: Cover of the book, not a printed page. The only lettering is a tiny tooled inscription at the foot of the central panel, too worn and small to read reliably, so it is not transcribed. The metal clasps, bands and blind-tooled ornament are part of the binding and are described only here.
